# Quantum-Pump-State-Crossover

> Controlled coherent-pump crossover: correct photon statistics, non-Gaussian joint output.

- [Model and claims](research/CLAIMS.md): preparation, scaling and exact scope.
- [Theorem](research/THEOREM.md): uniform state limit, energy, purity, counts and quadrature laws.
- [Proof map](research/PROOF_MAP.md): dependencies and supporting derivations.
- [Contribution review](research/REVIEW.md): interpretation after full attribution.
- [Source record](research/SOURCES.md): inspected passages and access boundaries.
- [Reproducibility](REPRODUCIBILITY.md): immutable evidence and assertion/report distinctions.
- [Current Chat work](CURRENT.md): continuation without a workspace.
- [Agent instructions](AGENTS.md): scope and preservation.

## Manuscript scientific account
- [Validity window](research/VALIDITY_WINDOW.md): finite-error extension, accurate counts and distance one from pure states.
- [Manuscript basis](research/MANUSCRIPT_BASIS.md): claim hierarchy, proof dependencies and interpretation.
- [Source audit](research/MANUSCRIPT_SOURCE_AUDIT.md): earlier same-model criteria and exact attribution boundaries.
- [Figures and data](manuscript/FIGURES.md): reproducible analytical formulas, not device simulations.

## Purpose and contact

This repository serves as a record of the work and a guide for the author’s
self-directed learning. For discussion or potential collaboration, please
contact Ruge Lin at [gogoko699@gmail.com](mailto:gogoko699@gmail.com).

## Analytical and source review
- [Author account](research/AUTHOR_ACCOUNT.md): compact claims-first interpretation.
- [Proof review](research/PROOF_REVIEW.md): domains, exact remainder checks, finite first-crossing certificates.
- [Source review](research/SOURCE_REVIEW.md): established phase-mixture family versus the pure-coherent-pump dynamical limit.
